d: UCC Energy is looking for an experienced Accountant with strong hands-on experience in upstream oil & gas accounting and Joint Venture (JV) accounting. The role will support operated and non-operated assets, partner accounting, cash calls, billing, cost recovery and financial reporting.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline .
Strong recent hands-on experience within an oil & gas operator and/or complex JV environment .
Good knowledge of JOA/PSC, JVA/JIB, cash calls, partner billing, AFEs and JV accounting .
Experience across the upstream E&P lifecycle .
Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CPA or CMA , completed or in progress.
Strong ERP and Excel skills; SAP/SAP JVA experience is an advantage.
Professional English and willingness to be based in Doha, Qatar .
r: li
Manage JV accounting (JVA/JIB) for operated and non-operated oil & gas assets.
li
Prepare and reconcile cash calls, partner billings and JV accounts .
li
Support monthly close and upstream accounting activities.
li
Handle AFE accounting, exploration & evaluation costs, DD&A, impairment and decommissioning provisions .
li
Support JOA/PSC accounting , including cost recovery, cost/profit oil, royalties and partner entitlements.
li
Reconcile partner accounts and resolve accounting discrepancies.
li
Support JV audits and ensure accurate, audit-ready financial records.
li
Maintain accurate accounting data within ERP/SAP systems.

q: As Restaurant Manager at Hawar Resort by Mantis, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of our restaurants across the resort, with a particular focus on our signature Italian speciality restaurant. You will be responsible for delivering exceptional dining experiences that reflect the resort’s luxury positioning, combining outstanding service, authentic culinary experiences, and warm, personalized hospitality.
What Is In It For You
Unleash the excitement: enticing rewards and unbeatable benefits are waiting for you!
Ignite your skills with our cutting-edge Academies for rapid professional growth.

Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Hospitality Management, Restaurant Management, Food & Beverage Management, or a related field.

Professional Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in food and beverage operations, including at least 3 years in a Restaurant Manager or equivalent leadership position within a luxury hotel, resort, or high-end standalone restaurant.

Luxury Dining Experience: Proven experience managing upscale or luxury dining operations, with experience in speciality restaurants strongly preferred. Exposure to Michelin-starred or award-winning establishments would be a distinct advantage.

Italian Restaurant Experience: Previous experience in an Italian restaurant or Italian speciality dining concept is highly desirable, with a strong understanding of Italian cuisine, regional food traditions, wine, and the service expectations associated with premium Italian dining.
Financial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to manage restaurant budgets, control labour and operating costs, maximize revenue, improve average spending, and achieve financial targets.

Leadership and Communication: Excellent leadership, interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to motivate a diverse team and maintain high standards in a demanding hospitality environment.
Food and Beverage Expertise: Strong knowledge of restaurant service, menu engineering, food and beverage pairing, wine service, guest relations, and contemporary dining trends.
Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in restaurant POS systems, reservation platforms, inventory management tools, reporting systems, and Microsoft Office Suite.

Cultural Awareness: Strong understanding of international guest expectations and cultural preferences, with familiarity with Middle Eastern dining customs and service considerations considered an advantage.
Regional Experience: Previous experience in Bahrain or the wider Middle East is preferred.

Personal Attributes: Professional, guest-focused, commercially aware, detail-oriented, and passionate about delivering exceptional hospitality. Demonstrates initiative, adaptability, integrity, and a genuine commitment to team development and continuous improvement.
Flexibility: Willingness to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, public holidays, and late-night operations, in line with the needs of a luxury island resort.
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.
